bundle.shortDescription: Watch Twitch VODs on a delayed, simulated-live schedule
bundle.longDescription: Twitch Timeshift replays VODs on a simulated schedule: each broadcast is shifted by a fixed delay you choose (for example 24 hours), and you join mid-VOD at the position a live viewer would be at. Times are displayed in your chosen timezone; the delay itself is a fixed number of hours, so local start times move by an hour across daylight-saving changes. The player keeps Twitch's own controls.
